title: Terms & Conditions
description: Terms for shopping with Luvia Creations, including orders, payments, delivery, cancellations and customer support.

sections.title: Shopping with Luvia Creations
sections.text: These terms apply to purchases from Luvia Creations through luviacreations.com. We offer handmade crochet products from Gurugram, Haryana, India. Please review the product description, selected variant, price and these terms before ordering. Contact hello@luviacreations.com or +91 92059 07350 for questions.

sections.title: Products and customisation
sections.text: Minor stitch, colour and size variations can occur in handmade products, but items must match their advertised description. Some lifestyle images are AI-assisted and may not reproduce every detail exactly; ask for an actual product photograph if needed. Customisation, availability, additional costs and timing must be agreed before ordering.

sections.title: Prices and payment
sections.text: Prices are in Indian rupees. Shipping charges, if applicable, are shown before payment. Review the delivery address, applicable coupon, shipping charge and total before payment. Online payments are processed through Razorpay, and orders are confirmed only after payment verification. Adding to a cart or sending a WhatsApp message does not confirm an order. If payment fails or money is debited without confirmation, contact orders@luviacreations.com before paying again.

sections.title: Delivery
sections.text: Online checkout supports delivery within India. International orders are by enquiry and subject to destination and product availability. Before international payment, we confirm supported payment options, shipping charges, tracking availability and estimated dispatch and delivery timelines in an individual quote. Indian checkout shipping offers do not apply. Import duties, taxes and clearance charges may apply; responsibility is explained in the quote before payment. Customs clearance may cause delays. Preparation and delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees. Provide accurate contact and address details and notify us promptly of corrections.

sections.title: Cancellations, returns and refunds
sections.text: You may request cancellation before dispatch. Defective, damaged or incorrect items are covered by our Return and Refund Policy, including customised items. Change-of-mind returns are not accepted. Please read that policy for reporting deadlines, return instructions, shipping responsibility and refund timelines. For international orders, cancellation, return and refund arrangements, including return-shipping costs, are explained before payment. Contact us before sending a return. These terms and any individual quote do not limit applicable statutory consumer rights.

sections.title: Your account and use of the website
sections.text: Guest ordering is available. If you create an account, keep your sign-in credentials secure and provide accurate information. Do not misuse the website, attempt unauthorised access or submit fraudulent orders. Do not share a card PIN, OTP or password with us through messages.

sections.title: Support and updates
sections.text: For order or payment issues, email orders@luviacreations.com with your order reference. General questions can be sent to hello@luviacreations.com or +91 92059 07350. Updates to these terms will be published here with a revised date; changes do not remove rights relating to an existing purchase. Applicable Indian law and statutory consumer protections apply.

title: Privacy Policy
description: How Luvia Creations uses customer information for accounts, orders, payments, delivery, support and website analytics.

sections.title: Who we are and how to contact us
sections.text: Luvia Creations operates luviacreations.com from Gurugram, Haryana, India. For privacy questions or requests about your information, email hello@luviacreations.com. For order support, email orders@luviacreations.com or contact +91 92059 07350.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.text: We use the name, mobile number, email address, delivery address, pincode, cart contents, order details and messages you provide to operate the shop and fulfil orders. Optional accounts involve authentication and saved delivery details. We also process technical information such as browser and device information, page visits and interactions for security and analytics.

sections.title: How information is used
sections.text: We use information to maintain your cart, calculate shipping, process and verify payment, fulfil and track orders, provide order updates, manage accounts, apply eligible offers, respond to support requests and prevent fraud. Website analytics help us understand shopping activity and improve the service.

sections.title: Payments and service providers
sections.text: Our payment service provider processes online payments and handles payment details entered in its secure checkout. Our order records use payment and transaction references for verification and support, not your card PIN or OTP. We use database, account authentication, hosting, image delivery, email and courier service providers to operate the shop and fulfil orders. Analytics and advertising service providers may receive page, device, interaction and purchase-event data when configured. These providers may process information outside India under their own privacy terms.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
sections.text: The website uses browser storage and caching to maintain carts, sign-in sessions, checkout recovery and a faster browsing experience. The latest eight submitted search keywords are saved in this browser on this device, not synced to an account. You can remove individual recent searches or clear them all from the search page. Analytics and advertising services may use cookies or similar technologies. Our security and bot-protection services process browser signals when configured. Browser settings can restrict cookies or clear stored data, but doing so may interrupt sign-in, cart or payment recovery.

sections.title: Messaging, reviews and external services
sections.text: When you choose an external messaging service or another external link, information you send is handled by that service under its privacy terms. If you opt in to a customer-review survey after an order, your order reference, email, delivery country and an estimated delivery date are shared with the review service provider for the survey. Review-survey participation is optional.

sections.title: Artisan applications
sections.text: Artisan applications are by private admin invitation. Links expire 24 hours after creation or after one submission. We use the invited recipient's name, email or WhatsApp number and the submitted contact, location, skills, availability, optional portfolio and work preferences to review suitability and coordinate a possible paid trial. Applications, internal reviews and versioned material-dispatch acknowledgements are private. One optional masked Aadhaar or alternative ID photo may be provided with separate consent for manual identity review, not Aadhaar authentication; alternatives can be arranged directly. ID images are stored privately in the database and available only to recently MFA-verified administrators; views are recorded. They are accessible for at most 30 days and deleted by the next hourly cleanup, or earlier after review. Normal private backup retention can outlast live deletion. Do not submit a full Aadhaar number, QR/barcode, bank details or OTP. Unapproved applications are deleted after 180 days without an update, along with their review history. Unlinked invitations are removed after 180 days. Approved and inactive profiles are retained while needed for the relationship and applicable legal obligations. Portfolio review is not publicity permission. Analytics and advertising tracking are disabled on the application page. Contact hello@luviacreations.com for access, alternative verification, correction, deletion or privacy questions.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.text: Saved delivery details associated with a cart may remain available for up to 30 days. Account, confirmed-order, payment and support records may be retained longer for fulfilment, accounting, dispute handling and applicable legal obligations. We use access controls and service-provider security measures, but no online system can guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Your choices and requests
sections.text: You can shop as a guest, edit delivery details before ordering and contact us to request access, correction or deletion of your information or to raise a privacy concern. We may need to verify your identity and retain records required for legal obligations or unresolved transactions. Contact hello@luviacreations.com for assistance. We will publish policy updates here with a revised date.
